footerTip.message: Tip: open chrome://discards to see the Auto Discardable column — protected tabs show ✕. Note: manual discards there still work; this only blocks Chrome's automatic memory-saver discarding.

heroEyebrow.description: Small eyebrow text above the welcome title.

heroTitle.message: Keep the tabs that matter alive

heroLead.message: Chrome's Memory Saver unloads idle tabs to free RAM, then reloads them when you return. Keep Tabs Alive lets you choose which tabs stay active and ready — preventing unwanted reloads and interruptions.
heroLead.description: Intro paragraph on the welcome page.

wcard1Text.message: Open tabs stay ready to use, with their page state and ongoing work intact — no unexpected reloads.

wcard2Text.message: The settings page lists every open tab with its own switch. Keep one tab alive or let another sleep — it overrides the rules just for that tab.

wcard3Text.message: Protect everything except a few sites, or whitelist only the ones you choose. Rules match subdomains too — example.com covers all of it.
wcard3Text.description: Welcome card 3 body. Keep the <code> tag.

chooseYourSites.description: Primary call-to-action button on the welcome page.

actionsNote.message: Prefer to protect everything by default? You can switch modes in settings.

welcomeStep1.message: Pin it for one-click access: click the 🧩 puzzle icon in the toolbar, then the pin.
welcomeStep1.description: Welcome footer step 1. Keep the inline tags and the puzzle emoji.

welcomeStep2.message: Verify any time at chrome://discards — protected tabs show ✕ in the Auto Discardable column.
welcomeStep2.description: Welcome footer step 2. Keep the inline tags and chrome://discards literal.

tourMasterBody.message: Turn all protection on or off here. While it's off, every tab is free to be discarded — your rules are kept, just paused.

tourModeBody.message: Whitelist only keeps just the sites you choose alive (the gentle default). Protect everything keeps every tab alive except the ones you exclude.
tourModeBody.description: Tour step body. Keep the <b> tags.

tourTabsBody.message: Every open tab has its own switch. Flip it to keep that single tab alive or let it sleep — a one-time choice that lasts until the tab is closed. Want it forever? Click Always for this site next to the switch to turn it into a permanent site rule. Click a row to jump to the tab.
tourTabsBody.description: Tour step body. Keep the <b> tags.

tourRulesBody.message: Add domains here to protect (or exclude) whole sites at once. A domain also covers its subdomains — example.com matches mail.example.com. That's the tour — reopen it any time from the ? button.
tourRulesBody.description: Tour step body. Keep the <code> tags.

tourBack.description: Tour: go to the previous step.

tourNext.description: Tour: go to the next step.

tourDone.description: Tour: finish on the last step.
